item.title: Gifts for New Nurse Graduates: 10 Ideas for Pinning and Graduation
item.description: Gifts for new nurse graduates that get used from the first shift: compression socks, a badge reel, a work bag and more. Ten ideas for pinning ceremonies and graduation, from a nurse-run site. Guide contains affiliate links.
